about: The bestiary remodel (Philip's rulings, 2026-10-12): every enemy an original generated creature from a parametric body plan; no KayKit, no playable-race bodies, no people. Heights are standing height in metres (a quadruped's shoulder-to-crown, a bird's crown, a wisp's trail top), footprints the collision radius. A dungeon monster's height is capped at the lowest ceiling it spawns under or can chase into (AGGRO 12 m) minus 1.5 m.

canine.name: Canine
canine.look: A lean quadruped on long legs: deep chest, tucked belly, a long muzzle and tall ears, the tail a flag. Built to read at a glance as wolf, fox or hound by proportion alone (leg length, muzzle, ear size, tail), with the FFXIV wolf's narrow waist and big forepaws. Fur is a few broad planes with a ruff, not strands.
params: leg length and chest depth (pup, wolf, hound)
muzzle length, ear size and set
a collar or harness (the imperial hounds)

feline.name: Feline
feline.look: A low, long cat: small head, big paws, a heavy tail used in every pose, shoulders that roll when it walks. The panther is all shoulder and tail; the house cat and snow cat are the same rig at kitten proportions with a rounder face.

cervid.name: Cervid
cervid.look: A tall deer on fine legs with a long neck and an upright head; the weight of the silhouette is the antlers. Stags carry a wide rack, the striders a light brow-tine and a longer stride. Every NM stag is the same rig at 2.5-3x with a rack that becomes the creature's story (mirror glass, ember, run to glass).
params: moss, glass or amber growths on the rack

suid.name: Suid
suid.look: A boar: a wedge of a body, all shoulder and head, short legs, tusks that curl up past the snout, a bristle crest down the spine. Shoats are the same rig small and smooth; the old ones are broad, scarred and crested.

bovid.name: Bovid
bovid.look: A heavy ox with a dewlap, a wide boss of horn and a tail that swings; slow and square, the one beast that stands its ground.

small_mammal.name: Small mammal
small_mammal.look: One compact rig for the hares, rats and the looters: a rounded body on short legs, a big head, expressive ears and a tail that says what it is (hare scut, rat whip, otter paddle, raccoon rings). The hoarders carry a visible pouch, cheek or crop. Crafted, not chibi: real feet, real claws, fur in planes.
params: ear form (hare, rat, badger, otter, raccoon)

amphibian.name: Amphibian
amphibian.look: A frog or toad: wide mouth, eyes set on top, the hind legs folded under and ready. The frogs are glossy and small; the toads are warty, broad and sit low. Old Bellwether is the toad rig at four metres with a crown.

reptile.name: Reptile / drake
reptile.look: A two-legged drake with a long balancing tail, a narrow head, small forelimbs and a dorsal frill, the FFXIV raptor silhouette; the lizards and the gecko are the same rig gone four-legged and low, with splayed toes. Scales are broad plates, not a texture.
params: plating: glass, amber, slate, dried husk

crustacean.name: Crustacean
crustacean.look: A crab, crayfish or hermit: a carapace on eight jointed legs with two claws of unequal size. Crabs are wide and sideways; the crayfish is long with a fanned tail; the hermit wears what it found (a strongbox, a keg) as its shell.

insect.name: Insect / arachnid
insect.look: Six or eight legs under an armoured body: beetles domed and slow, wasps slim with a hanging sting and wings that blur, the ant a horse-sized worker with a sack-carrying gait, the spider low and wide with a snow-pale abdomen.

bird.name: Bird
bird.look: One bird rig at several silhouettes: hen (round, upright), pigeon and dove (small, neat), corvid (long bill, hunched), gull (long wings, hooked), heron (long legs and neck), raptor (broad wings, talons; the vulture adds a bare neck and a ruff), bowerbird (crested, long tail), loon (low on the water, dagger bill). Feathers are planes with a few long primaries.

fish.name: Fish / eel / leech
fish.look: A swimming body that fights out of the water: the pike a long torpedo with a shovel jaw, the eel a ribbon with a fin the whole length, the leech a blunt segmented tube with a sucker.

ooze.name: Ooze
ooze.look: A slime: a soft dome that settles and rebounds, a single bright core, a few trapped things in it (petals, straw, cinders, pearls). Moves by heaving. Whimsy at low level, but a crafted jelly, not a cartoon blob.

wisp.name: Wisp / spirit
wisp.look: A hovering light with a drawn shape: a body of trailing veils around a bright core, no feet. The choristers are hooded and hold a hymn pose; the dancers are a waltzing pair of empty gowns; the field wisps are a flame-form of a few long tongues. Casters all; emissive carries the look.

husk.name: Undead husk
husk.look: The hollowed: a servant who did not leave, dried to a shell. Upright, thin, head bowed, hands long; the surface is cracked like old lacquer and the inside is dark, with a dim light in the chest. Not a skeleton: there are no bones, only the hollow. Drowned ones hang with weed and drip; keepers are taller and carry a lantern; clerks are bent over a ledger.
params: crusts: amber, iron, glass, weed, frost
carried object: lantern, ledger, bell, fiddle

sentinel.name: Sentinel / construct
sentinel.look: The empire's caretaker, an empty suit of imperial plate that walks: no face in the helm, a lamp-glow where one would be, the plates floating a finger apart on a dark core. Field sentinels carry their tool (saw, shears, dredge, scythe, tally-board, lantern); the ramparts and the Household are heavier, with pauldrons and a tabard. Every boss sentinel is a different office of the same household, read in its silhouette.

rooted.name: Rooted / growth
rooted.look: Things the gardens and the fen grew: a mushnub is a walking cap on stubby legs (whimsy, crafted); a rootbound thing is a mass of roots in the shape of whoever they grew through, heavy and slow; the sedge mother and the Thirst are the same idea at boss scale.

giant.name: Giant / ogre-ish beast
giant.look: A shaggy biped with long arms, a small head sunk in the shoulders and a slow, rolling walk: the Old Man of the Road under snow, the ash giants under burnt glass. Readable from across a zone.
